webBackend.unreadableData: Error shown when the data saved by the web app in the browser is damaged.
webBackend.proxyAnswered: {{status}} is an HTTP status code. The proxy is the server that forwards requests for the web app.
webBackend.cancelled: Reason text in lower case, shown after the title of a cancelled request.
webBackend.streamCutOff: Error shown when the connection to the proxy ends before a stream finishes.
